description: Ministry of Agriculture Land, Irrigation, Fisheries Animal Production, Health and Agrarian Development - Statute of Animal Production and Health of Western Province No. 01 of 2023
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the establishment of a new legal/regulatory framework - the "Statute of Animal Production and Health of Western Province No. 01 of 2023." It creates a new provincial department, defines its objectives, powers, functions, and establishes regulatory requirements for animal-related institutions. This fits Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory) as it involves the creation of new statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks rather than government personnel changes or organizational restructuring without legal authority.
